Description: Caster can move one object, up to 1 pound in mass, up to 1' per second (with no acceleration). If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up, the object remains stationary as if it had a Staying spell with an equal weight limit cast upon it
Exerts 5 pounds of pressure on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by Staying alone and pressure can only be in one direction
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 5 pounds
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 25 pounds
As Staying II, except 2 objects may be affected with 5 pounds total pressure or Staying II can be used to 200'
As Telekinesis I, except 2 objects of 5 pounds total mass may be moved or Telekinesis I can be used at 200'
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 25 pounds
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 50 pounds
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 50 pounds

Caster may "hurl" one object (that starts within 10' of him) of 1 pound or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with a maximum range of 300' (see Arms Law). The caster's OB will equal his directed spell skill with this spell. If Arms Law is not available, use the Shock Bolt Attack Table (with a maximum range of 300') with Impact Critical results
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 100 pounds
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 100 pounds
As Hurling I, except mass limit is 5 pounds and it delivers double normal concussion hits
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 200 pounds
As Greater Staying II, except 3 objects may be affected with 25 pounds total pressure or Staying I can be used to 300'
As Telekinesis I, except 3 objects of 25 pounds total mass may be moved or Telekinesis I can be used to 300'
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 200 pounds
As Hurling II, except limit is 25 pounds and delivers triple normal concussion hits
As Staying II, except pressure limit is 20 pounds per level
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 20 pounds per level
As Hurling I, except the object to be hurled may start up to 300' away or the caster may hurl 3 objects that start up to 100' away (at the same target)
As Hurling II, except limit is 50 pounds and it delivers four times normal concussion hits and the OB has an additional +50 bonus
Each round, the caster may use any lower level spell on this list with a range of 300'. CLOSED MENTALISM 4.2.10 TELEKINESIS
